title: [CQ-I06a] JetBrains plan review disconnect release
description:
Objective: make the JetBrains plan review handle a lost daemon connection the same way VS Code already does (moe-vscode PlanReviewPanel.handleConnectionChange; the human confirmed this recovery behaviour on 2026-09-11). A disconnect while an approval is PENDING ends that approval as not confirmed and re-arms the dialog for the SAME rendered revision.

Today PlanReviewDialog.onStatus is a no-op, and that causes two defects:
(a) The approve bytes can die with the socket. The reconnect snapshot then shows AWAITING_APPROVAL at the rendered revision, and the dialog stays PENDING ('approval in flight') until it is closed.
(b) The reconnect snapshot can show WORKING at the rendered revision. JetBrains then reports the approval as done, while VS Code reports it as not confirmed.
CQ-I06 DoD 1 ('Both clients consume identical daemon verdicts') needs one behaviour for both.

Deliverable:
- PlanReviewApprovalState.onConnectionLost(), which releases PENDING with a new CONNECTION_LOST_KEY 'moe.message.planReview.connectionLost' that is listed in allMessageKeys();
- PlanReviewDialog.onStatus(false, ...) calls it, and repaints on the EDT exactly as onError does;
- the MoeBundle.properties text, mirroring VS Code's wording;
- named tests in PlanReviewApprovalStateTest.

Out of scope:
- ERROR-frame codeName plumbing. JetBrains still re-arms on every daemon error. The daemon delivers frames in order, so a PLAN_REVISION_MISMATCH always arrives after the newer-revision frame, which has already latched the dialog.
- VS Code, the daemon, CLIENT_HELLO, and the shared verdict corpus (CQ-I06b).

Verification (run fresh, exit 0 required): cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test. WSL has no JDK, so run the Windows gradlew.bat equivalent under the jetbrains-gradle lease and label it as the Windows equivalent.
definitionOfDone: PlanReviewApprovalState.onConnectionLost() turns PENDING into READY with noticeKey moe.message.planReview.connectionLost and returns true. In AWAITING_RENDER, READY, INVALIDATED, FINISHED and DISPOSED it returns false and changes neither phase nor notice. New PlanReviewApprovalStateTest cases prove both.

After onConnectionLost, a WORKING snapshot at the captured revision ends INVALIDATED with STATUS_CHANGED_KEY and never FINISHED. An AWAITING_APPROVAL snapshot at the captured revision keeps approveEnabled true, and the next onApproveClicked returns Send with the captured revision. Named tests prove both.

PlanReviewDialog.onStatus(connected=false) calls approval.onConnectionLost() and repaints only when it returns true. onStatus(true) changes nothing. The new key is in allMessageKeys() and MoeBundle.properties, and the existing bundle guard test passes.
Fresh `cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test` exits 0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: JetBrains only: no moe-vscode, daemon or wire changes; the captured revision is never replaced or retried automatically.
